description: This file defines the 'Book' class within the 'Todaymade\Daux\Format\HTMLFile' namespace. The class is responsible for generating HTML content for a documentation book, including navigation, table of contents, cover, pages, and the overall HTML structure. It interacts with directory and content tree structures, applies styling, and assembles the final HTML document.

classes.name: Book
classes.description: A class that generates an HTML representation of a documentation book from a directory tree and configuration, including navigation, content pages, and styling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Book with a directory tree and configuration.

methods.name: getStyles
methods.description: Retrieves and embeds CSS styles from theme files.

methods.name: getPageUrl
methods.description: Generates a URL-friendly identifier for a page based on its URL.

methods.name: buildNavigation
methods.description: Recursively builds navigation structure from directory entries.

methods.name: renderNavigation
methods.description: Renders HTML for the navigation structure.

methods.name: generateTOC
methods.description: Creates the HTML for the Table of Contents.

methods.name: generateCover
methods.description: Creates the HTML for the cover page.

methods.name: generatePages
methods.description: Generates HTML for all content pages.

methods.name: addPage
methods.description: Adds a page's content to the internal pages list.

methods.name: generateHead
methods.description: Creates the HTML head section including metadata and styles.

methods.name: generateBody
methods.description: Assembles the HTML body including cover, TOC, and pages.
